issue.title: [N / ]N group jumps for days, periods, records, and any note
issue.description: `[N` / `]N` (and `[{` / `]}` after any `n` walk) open the first note of the previous / next group on every canonical daily, week, and quarter note, on records of albums that set `walk_by`, and on any note whose nav line carries `«` / `»` links. `[n` / `]n` walk a grouped album one group at a time. The property card's docked rail and the links walker footer show the same group stops, and a stop whose note does not exist yet looks clearly, calmly different from one that will never be created.
